items.statement: The investigation independently generates and documents multiple mechanistic candidates, then validates the selected stationary points and connectivity before comparing energetics.
items.expected: The report contains candidate-specific identities/provenance, frequency validation, H-transfer mode assignment, and an IRC or equivalent reactant/product connection test.

items.statement: A source-supported radical elementary channel involves methane hydrogen transfer to HSO4• and formation of a methyl-radical product-side state.
items.expected: The independent report identifies and validates the CH4/HSO4• H-transfer channel with atom-conserving product-side radical assignment.

items.statement: The source reference places the solution-phase Gibbs barrier for this HAT channel near 11 kcal/mol.
items.expected: When the channel is successfully validated, the submitted barrier is near 11.4 kcal/mol and is explicitly tied to the submitted reactant reference state; a bounded failure must explain why no validated value was obtained.
